artifacts.summary: Identifies the live extract_local.py pipeline (not upload.py) as the active transcript-capture path, establishes from vendor code that a client-supplied provenance field survives to the stored KO (server only synthesizes one when absent), and recommends a new extension-owned script rewriting pending_kos.jsonl's provenance field between sapience sync and sapience review to inject [repo:<slug>]. Confirms no backfill API exists for already-uploaded untagged KOs.

memory_candidates.content: Sapience's live transcript-capture pipeline on a backend=anthropic/openai/ollama/relay machine is extract_local.py (sapience sync/review/pending/backfill), not upload.py -- upload.py is imported only as a session-reader library (import upload as up). upload.py's own _chunk()/post_kos() duplicate functions are a separate, unused 'default uploader' streaming path. per-repo-scoping.md's claim about upload.py's _chunk() dropping project before storage describes that dead path, not the live one.

Sapience's /ingest-kos endpoint only synthesizes a provenance string from tool/sid/at when the posted KO lacks a provenance field; a client-supplied provenance (as tag_cowork_ko/tag_devin_ko/tag_memory_ko already demonstrate in extract_local.py, and as sapience-remember.sh's direct POST relies on) survives verbatim. This means a pre-review rewrite of a locally staged KO's provenance field (before sapience review posts it) is sufficient to make it discoverable via a source=[repo:<slug>] filtered search.

~/.sapience/pending_kos.jsonl is a LEDGER_FILE (per extract_local.py's LEDGER_FILES tuple), explicitly preserved across `sapience update`/auto-update -- unlike the vendor CLIENT_FILES scripts (extract_local.py, upload.py, etc.) which ARE overwritten. A fix that only mutates this ledger file (never a vendor script) is durable across every future vendor auto-update, which is the key property for anything 'owned by' a source-store extension that cannot edit ~/.sapience/ directly.
